Woman faces FIR for damaging property at Bhubaneswar airport after flight cancellation

A woman has been booked under an FIR for allegedly damaging property worth ₹49,000 at Bhubaneswar Airport following the cancellation of an IndiGo flight. The incident occurred after the flight's cancellation, leading to a ruckus. The FIR was filed against the woman for the damage caused.
